columns.name: sku_family_id
columns.reason: Static product master data attached to the order line at entry.

columns.name: cube_utilisation_p50
columns.reason: Reads as a historical percentile utilisation statistic computed before this order runs.

columns.name: freight_class_code
columns.reason: Freight classification is set from the commodity at order booking.

columns.name: pick_sla_breach_flag
columns.reason: Records a picking SLA breach that only occurs during fulfilment, after prediction.

columns.name: dock_dwell_p90
columns.reason: A p90 dwell statistic implies an aggregate over prior activity rather than this order's dwell.

columns.name: wave_priority_code
columns.reason: Priority is assigned when the order is released into a wave.

columns.name: pallet_pattern_id
columns.reason: Pallet configuration is static item master data.

columns.name: sort_zone_code
columns.reason: Sort zone follows deterministic destination routing rules known at release.

columns.name: aisle_zone
columns.reason: Slotting location of the SKU is known before picking starts.

columns.name: delivery_scan_delta_h
columns.reason: Derived from the delivery scan, which happens after prediction and effectively encodes lateness.

columns.name: conveyor_lane
columns.reason: The lane the carton actually travelled is assigned at induct/sortation, after release.

columns.name: edi_partner_id
columns.reason: Trading partner identity arrives with the inbound EDI order.

columns.name: order_channel_code
columns.reason: Channel is fixed the moment the order is captured.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q1
columns.reason: Prior-period quarterly volume aggregate, already recorded before this order.

columns.name: trailer_door_id
columns.reason: The actual dock door used is tied to trailer loading, downstream of the prediction point.

columns.name: shift_code
columns.reason: The processing shift is set by the planned wave schedule at release.

columns.name: insert_leaflet_code
columns.reason: Insert selection is driven by order-entry rules, not by fulfilment outcome.

columns.name: final_transit_hours
columns.reason: Final transit duration is only known once the shipment has been delivered.

columns.name: tote_type
columns.reason: Container type comes from cartonisation performed at wave planning.

columns.name: pallet_weight_kg
columns.reason: Weight is computable from ordered lines and item master before picking.

columns.name: bill_to_account
columns.reason: Billing account is part of the order header at capture.

columns.name: origin_dock_backlog
columns.reason: Current dock backlog is an observable facility state at prediction time.

columns.name: audit_sample_flag
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether audit selection is drawn up front or applied at post-pack QC.

columns.name: carrier_cutoff_missed_flag
columns.reason: Whether the carrier cutoff was missed is only settled at ship time, after prediction.

columns.name: returns_prior_q2
columns.reason: Explicitly a prior-quarter returns aggregate, already final.

columns.name: order_line_count
columns.reason: Line count is fixed when the order is received.

columns.name: label_printer_id
columns.reason: A printer is recorded only when the shipping label is produced at pack.

columns.name: customer_region_code
columns.reason: Ship-to region is known from the order header.

columns.name: pallet_licence_plate
columns.reason: An LPN exists only once the pallet is physically built, after prediction.

columns.name: packaging_class
columns.reason: Packaging classification is an item/order attribute known before fulfilment.

columns.name: promo_units_q2
columns.reason: Historical quarterly promotional volume, recorded before this order.

columns.name: hazmat_class
columns.reason: Hazmat classification is static item master data.

columns.name: pack_station_id
columns.reason: The station where the order was actually packed is recorded during execution.

columns.name: ship_complete_flag
columns.reason: Ship-complete is a customer order instruction supplied at order entry.

columns.name: load_sequence
columns.reason: Loading position is determined while the trailer is being built, after prediction.

columns.name: route_wave_id
columns.reason: The planned route/wave assignment exists when the order is released.

columns.name: expedite_fee_usd
columns.reason: Expedite charges are typically incurred to recover an order already running late.

columns.name: service_credit_usd
columns.reason: Service credits are issued after a service failure has occurred.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q4
columns.reason: Prior-period quarterly outbound volume aggregate.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q2
columns.reason: Prior-period quarterly outbound volume aggregate.

columns.name: carrier_account_id
columns.reason: Carrier account is selected at order rating/booking, before fulfilment.

columns.name: replen_shortfall_units
columns.reason: Replenishment shortfall is an inventory state observable at wave release.

columns.name: pick_path_metres
columns.reason: Pick path length is computed by the WMS when the wave is planned.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q3
columns.reason: Prior-period quarterly outbound volume aggregate.

columns.name: returns_prior_q1
columns.reason: Explicitly a prior-quarter returns aggregate, already final.

columns.name: promo_units_q1
columns.reason: Historical quarterly promotional volume, recorded before this order.
